description: Holds receipt details records, linked to receipt header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report receipt details records, including amounts and quantities, for the System & Communication area.
record_granularity: One row represents one receipt detail.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the receipt detail.

columns.name: refNo
columns.description: Ref no reference of the receipt detail.

columns.name: debit_amount
columns.description: Debit amount of the receipt detail.

columns.name: ReceiptHeaderid
columns.description: Reference to the receipt header linked to this receipt detail.

relationships.description: Each receipt detail references one receipt header (receipt header).

business_rules: Use debit_amount for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Receipt Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Debit Amount per receipt detail

common_queries: Top receipt header by debit amount

known_issues: debit_amount is stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
debit_amount is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name ReceiptDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting receipt detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(debit_amount) for totals of debit amount.
To resolve names, join on: ReceiptHeaderid = ReceiptHeader.id.
